about_the_game:
A crash leaves you stranded and alone in a remote lab while war rages across the surface. With nowhere else to go, you descend into dark alien dungeons to extract rare minerals and bring them back to automate your growing facility. Balance the tension of surviving monstrous horrors below with the satisfaction of building a complex, fully automated sci-fi factory above. Uncover secrets buried deep in this hostile world and fight to keep yourself alive.

  • Explore

    Venture into procedurally generated alien dungeons full of hidden minerals and lurking dangers. Each descent is unique and keeps you on edge.

  • Fight

    Face off against monstrous creatures that guard the depths. Use powerful firearms and stay alert: death can come quickly in the dark.

  • Mine & Harvest                                                                                                                                    

    Extract rare minerals with your mining tools and bring them back to the surface. Every haul fuels your expansion and pushes you deeper into the unknown.

  • Build & Automate

    Construct machines, conveyor belts and advanced processors to transform raw minerals into vital components. Set up intricate production lines and watch your lab grow into a sprawling automated factory.

  • Your robot is your inventory                                                                                                              

    Manage your limited resources carefully, both deep underground and back at your lab. With no on-screen UI to guide you, your robot is the only inventory you have. Build and customize it to fit your needs, and plan every descent to keep your operation running.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat with monsters, mild stylized violence and dark environments that may be unsettling to some players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
